rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body lead-in mirrors prompt's opening phrasing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verify session boundary before deciding prompt's context-carrying.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The primitives prompt (marker at L51, curriculum/prompts/spot-gaps-build-the-loop-primitives.md L19) says 'Then evaluate fit for the dominant gap I named in Phase 1.' Checked whether 'Phase 1' actually reached the agent: curriculum/prompts/spot-gaps-build-the-loop-1.md (the prompt that produced the gap ranking, in the sibling exercise curriculum/exercises/spot-gaps-build-the-loop.md) never uses the string 'Phase 1' anywhere in its own fenced text — 'Phase 1' exists only in that other file's body headers and maintainer notes, never typed into a prior prompt. This is the exact 40b failure shape (a curriculum-coined event label surviving into a warm-session prompt with no referent in scrollback), though 'the dominant gap' itself IS genuinely in scrollback via that prompt's own ranking output, so the practical risk is Claude ignoring the unresolvable 'Phase 1' qualifier rather than misfiring on it. No 40a issue.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Drop 'in Phase 1' and anchor to the in-scrollback artifact directly, e.g. 'the dominant gap you ranked highest a moment ago'.
